context: Tests: requirements gathering, scaffolding script use, reading references at generation time, required and default usage, validation hand-off.

checklist.name: Asks for the image
checklist.description: The agent asks which container image repository and tag to use instead of choosing one.

checklist.name: Asks for port and probes
checklist.description: The agent asks which port the application listens on and which health check endpoints it exposes.

checklist.name: Asks for limits and scaling
checklist.description: The agent asks for CPU and memory limits and whether autoscaling is needed, with min/max replicas and target CPU.

checklist.name: Asks for workload type and storage
checklist.description: The agent asks whether the workload is a Deployment, StatefulSet or DaemonSet and whether persistent storage is needed.

checklist.name: No silent assumptions
checklist.description: The agent does not generate the chart with guessed values before the questions are answered.

checklist.name: Uses the scaffolding script
checklist.description: After the answers, the chart is created with `bash scripts/generate_chart_structure.sh <chart-name> <output-dir>` and the relevant options.

checklist.name: Image passed without a tag
checklist.description: The `--image` option receives only the repository name, not `repo:tag`.

checklist.name: Helpers script run
checklist.description: The standard helpers are produced with the helpers script or the helpers template.

checklist.name: References read at template stage
checklist.description: The agent reads the resource templates and template functions references immediately before writing templates.

checklist.name: Required and default used
checklist.description: Templates use `required` for mandatory values and `default` for optional fallbacks rather than rendering empty strings.

checklist.name: Delegates validation
checklist.description: The agent hands the finished chart to the helm-validator skill rather than declaring it done unvalidated.
